requirements.text: The portal should allow patients to book appointments online but also provide the option to speak directly with staff.
Patients should be able to indicate urgent symptoms during the booking process, with those requests flagged for immediate review by staff.
The portal should include clear instructions for indicating urgency and provide confirmation messages explaining next steps.
There should be a mechanism for staff to quickly review flagged urgent cases to ensure timely attention.
Strong verification processes must be in place to secure patient data, with restricted access to sensitive information to prevent breaches.
